Just had a DEXA scan here and had a great experience from start to finish. The entire process was smooth, simple, and very professional—exactly what you would expect from a top-notch wellness clinic.

The staff made everything easy, the scan was quick, and the overall experience felt organized and high quality. The pricing is also very competitive, especially compared to other wellness and body composition testing options.

One thing I really liked is that they offer a great 2-for-1 option, which makes it easy to come back for a second scan and actually measure progress over time. That’s a huge benefit if you’re serious about tracking body composition, fat loss, muscle gain, or overall health improvements.

Highly recommend for anyone who wants real data instead of guessing.
